<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[TPRM assignment groups ensure AI Agent task routing and Now Assist escalations reach the correct risk and vendor management teams. Without properly configured groups, automated assignments from AI-generated risk actions will fail or go unaddressed.]]></ai_justification><check_name>TPRM Assignment Groups Configured</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(){
var ga=new GlideAggregate("sys_user_group");
ga.addQuery("name","CONTAINS","risk");
ga.addAggregate("COUNT");ga.query();
var c=ga.next()?parseInt(ga.getAggregate("COUNT")):0;
if(c>=2)return{status:"ready",actualValue:c+" groups",finding:c+" risk assignment groups found."};
if(c>0)return{status:"needs_attention",actualValue:c+" group",finding:c+" risk group found."};
return{status:"value_blocker",actualValue:"0 groups",finding:"No risk assignment groups found."};
})()]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>TPRM</module><number>CHK0001213</number><order/><remediation_guidance>Configure TPRM assignment groups aligned to risk tiers and vendor categories.</remediation_guidance><sys_class_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-18 08:00:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>d3e736edcf21c7d48935fb251d851cf2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>TPRM Assignment Groups Configured</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform" source="x_snc_airop">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_scope><sys_update_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition_d3e736edcf21c7d48935fb251d851cf2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-18 08:00:57</sys_updated_on></x_snc_airop_check_definition></record_update>
